params.name: limit
params.description: Max results per page. Default `1000`, max `5000`.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor returned in `cursor.next`. When provided, do not also supply `range`, `from`, or `to`.

params.name: range
params.description: Convenience range selector. If omitted and `from` is omitted, defaults to `last_day`.

params.name: from
params.description: Range start. Accepts an ISO 8601 timestamp or epoch milliseconds.

params.name: to
params.description: Range end. Accepts an ISO 8601 timestamp or epoch milliseconds. Defaults to now.

items.docs: Returns assistant conversations in a reporting-friendly row format (no message content, cursor pagination).
